items.title: Captain flavor
items.text:
A veteran sailor of haven ships, used to make supply runs
to the mainland.

mechanics.effect: Flavor line for the new character. haven is lowercase. No home and no age are printed.

items.title: Captain
items.text:
Captain. As a free action, discard a City card to
move from any port location to any other port
location on the grid if you can trace a sea route to it.

mechanics.effect: Discard a City card to move from any port on the grid to any other port on the grid if you can trace a sea route to it.
restrictions: Both locations are ports on the grid
You must be able to trace a sea route between them

items.title: Create a new character
items.text:
Immediately create a new character using this job.
Add that character to the pool of available characters.

mechanics.effect: Immediately create a new character with the Captain job and add that character to the pool of available characters. There is no portrait.

summary: Create a new character with the Captain job and add it to the available pool. No portrait, home, or age. Free action: discard a City card to move between ports on the grid along a traced sea route. The words sea route are not hyphenated. Corner badge on the flavor strip is 49. The instruction wording matches door 44; the files are not byte-identical.
